PROFILE SUMMARY

Dr. Hemant Makwana is a Professor in the Department of Information Technology at the Institute of Engineering & Technology (IET), DAVV, Indore, with over two decades of association with the institute as a student, researcher, and faculty member. He holds a Ph.D. in Software Engineering from DAVV Indore and specializes in Computer Graphics & Visualization and Biometrics & Security. He is an approved Ph.D. supervisor at DAVV, guiding doctoral research in Information Technology, and has authored peer-reviewed journal and conference publications with citations recorded on Google Scholar.
